purpose: Implement the fixed-purpose B13-C operational-health adapter defined by SC001-P1-OPS-001 and validate it only against synthetic fixtures. Do not deploy it and do not read any live collector state.
implementation_requirements: Expose no arbitrary path/unit/command selector to the caller.
Production identities are fixed in code: B13-C collector identity, fixed collector_state.json path, fixed sc001-b13c-liquidation.service unit.

Project only the allowlisted operational fields from the parent design; never return raw state JSON, symbol list, raw/event/invalid counts, message timestamps, prices, event sizes, clusters, frequencies, returns, PnL, raw exception text or log content.

Validate bounded JSON size, regular-file identity, no symlink substitution, exact expected stage/schema/version semantics and strict scalar types. Missing/permission/malformed/type mismatch fail closed to bounded error enums.
Do not default absent counters to zero. Preserve UNKNOWN/unavailable states.
Heartbeat freshness uses last_heartbeat_ms only; never substitute last_message_ms. Future heartbeat is anomalous, not fresh.
Use the prospectively frozen HEARTBEAT_STALE_AFTER_MS=90000 exactly; do not tune it after synthetic or live observations.
Systemd process-state query, if implemented, must use a fixed argument vector and fixed unit; no shell and no service-control verbs.
No writes/chmod/chown, no collector signals, no restart/daemon-reload, no sockets/network.

Provide synthetic validation for allowlist leakage, stale/future heartbeat semantics, malformed/oversized/wrong-version/type errors, symlink/FIFO/nonregular rejection, fixed-unit/path behavior, and isolation from raw/event/log/network/service-control access.
result_requirements: Offline Test Executor job id(s) and exit/log result
Safety receipts confirming no live/protected/collector access
Explicit statement that PASS authorizes no deployment or live read
Exact residual host-side/T3 requirements if any
terminal_rule: Persist implementation and test before execution. Run only the exact offline synthetic test. Persist the exact result document last among repository artifacts, then write one terminal receipt with CONTINUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true and STRATEGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false. Stop.
heartbeat_stale_threshold_rationale: Prospectively frozen before any live/protected access: 60s collector stale-connection bound + 30s heartbeat margin. This is an operational visibility threshold only, not evidence eligibility.
